title.suggested: Inscription on Tom Allen's English Championship Cup

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Republic quoted the inscription on the cup presented to Tom Allen by his admirers on May 22, 1878, kept behind his Market Street bar. The fragment is cut off on both sides.

metadata.notes: Masthead: The Republic: St. Louis, Mo., Sunday Morning, March 31, 1895, page 40.

facts.fact: A massive cup presented to Tom Allen by his admirers, inscribed with the date May 22, 1878, rested behind his bar on Market Street
Allen spoke of another fight in England with Jim Stewart
